text:
**My pick for a slim Qi2 power bank for iPhone 17: the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).** It is thin, supports real 15W Qi2 charging, and 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.

## Top picks

**1. Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim): best overall slim pick**
- 0.34 in thick, 4.3 oz, 5,000mAh, 15W Qi2 wireless, and 20W wired USB-C.
- 9to5Mac says it runs cooler than the competition and feels premium.
- Price: $54.99 on Anker's site.
- [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**2. INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2): best slim pick if you want more capacity**
- 10,000mAh, 0.5 in thick, 195g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank.
- It charges your iPhone 17 wirelessly at 25W, and wired at up to 45W. It has a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable and an LED display, but no kickstand.
- Price: about $42.99 on Amazon, per Android Central.
- [Android Central review, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**3. Baseus Picogo Air AM71: thinnest and lightest, but slower wireless**
- 0.27 in thick, 104g, 5,000mAh. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest it tested.
- Wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Price: $52.99 on Amazon. The Anker costs about the same and charges wirelessly twice as fast, so I'd choose the Anker unless thinness matters most.
- [Android Central review, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

## Things to know
- **Speed:** The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, but the Anker 5K tops out at 15W. If you want full speed, go with the INIU (or the Kuxiu S4, which Macworld also lists as a slim 25W 10K option).
- **Capacity:** A 5K bank usually gives about 60–75% of a charge, per Macworld. A 10K bank gives close to two full charges.
- **Cases:** Anker notes that thick, non-magnetic, or heavily armored cases (like OtterBox Defender) can interfere with charging.
- **Prices:** These are from the cited sources and may have changed. I couldn't check live listings.

Sources: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
